_meta.description: ScholarPilot catalog. Every entry was checked against its official pages on the date in `checked`; `sources` lists the pages read. Amounts and dates change every year, so the app always links the official page.

entry_fields.checked: date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was last verified against `sources`; entries with it are seeded as verified
entry_fields.sources: official pages and documents the facts were taken from

eligibility_fields.age_reference: {month, day, years_after_deadline}: the date on which age is measured; omit to use the deadline
eligibility_fields.min_grade_percent: school leavers: minimum HSSC / A-Level equivalent percentage
eligibility_fields.min_cgpa_percent: graduates: minimum CGPA as a percentage of the scale
eligibility_fields.max_years_since_graduation: degree must not be older than this
eligibility_fields.english: {required, accepted: {ielts, toefl_ibt, pte, duolingo}, note}; an empty `accepted` means proof is needed but the score is set by the university or course
eligibility_fields.requires_financial_need: true if the award is need-based
eligibility_fields.other: conditions the engine cannot check automatically

deadline_fields.month / day: the yearly deadline; omit both when each university or course sets its own
deadline_fields.approximate: true when the date is last cycle's and the new call is not out yet
deadline_fields.status: open | upcoming | closed | varies, as of `checked`
deadline_fields.note: the confirmed dates of the current or last cycle

retired.reason: The Australian Government ended new Destination Australia funding rounds from 1 July 2024.

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS - Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
scholarships.provider: DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service)
scholarships.funding_details: EUR 992 per month for graduates, for 12 to 42 months depending on the course, plus payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance and a travel allowance. Rent subsidy and family allowance only in certain cases. No tuition fees, but universities may charge registration or enrolment fees.
sources: DAAD EPOS FAQ (ST42, 06/2026) and EPOS list of application deadlines for intake 2027/2028

english.note: Each course sets its own English proof. German-taught courses need a B1 German certificate at application and DSH 2 or TestDaF 4 to enrol.

other: Bachelor's degree (usually a four-year course) in a subject related to the course
Above-average result in your degree (top third)
At least two years of relevant work experience after your bachelor's, at the time of application
No age limit, but your latest degree should not be older than 6 years
Only courses in the current EPOS list are funded; you may apply to up to three

deadline.note: Each course sets its own deadline (see the EPOS deadline list for intake 2027/2028). You don't need admission before applying. Most selections finish in March.

documents: Europass CV in reverse chronological order, with no unexplained gaps
One motivation letter (the same letter to every course, explaining your choices and priority)
Recommendation letter from your current employer (letterhead, signature, stamp, current date)
Employment certificates showing at least two years of relevant work after your bachelor's
Recent proof of language skills, as the course requires
Copies of degree certificates and the full transcript, with an explanation of the grading system
steps: Pick up to three courses from the current EPOS list and rank them
Check each course's own deadline, language rule and extra documents
Send the complete application directly to each university, not to DAAD
Shortlisted candidates get a telephone interview with the university
The university informs you of the result

scholarships.name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Master's Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance)
scholarships.provider: DAAD, funded by the German Federal Foreign Office
scholarships.funding_details: EUR 992 per month, health insurance in Germany, fixed travel allowances, a study and research grant, rent and family supplements where applicable, and a mandatory German course of up to 4 months before the master's. Scholarship holders pay no tuition fees.

english.note: All seven courses are taught in English; each course sets its own language proof.

other: First degree in Social and Political Sciences, Law, Economics, or Public Policy and Administration, with above-average grades (upper third)
Relevant practical experience (work, internships, political or community service); details vary by course
For the 2027 intake your last degree must be issued on or after 1 January 2020
Not eligible if you spent more than the past 15 months in a country that is not on the DAC list
If you already hold a master's, you must argue why you need another one

deadline.note: For the 2027 intake applications ran from 1 June to 31 July 2026. Selection is in October/November 2026 and results come in December 2026 or January 2027. The next call usually opens in June.

documents: Ticked checklist and list of criteria, signed by hand
One motivation letter (max. two pages) ranking your two course choices
Europass CV with the date added; explain gaps of three months or more
Copies of degree certificates and full transcripts with the grading system
Proof of work experience, internships or community service on headed paper, signed and stamped
Current reference letter from your employer (or a university lecturer if you are a student)
steps: Choose up to two of the seven Helmut-Schmidt master's courses
Fill in the DAAD application form once, naming your course(s)
Send the application directly to the course(s), not to DAAD, between 1 June and 31 July
If the selection committee proposes you, DAAD asks you to upload documents to its portal
Attend the German course in Germany before the master's starts

scholarships.name: Deutschlandstipendium
scholarships.provider: German federal government with private sponsors, paid through universities
scholarships.funding_details: EUR 300 per month (EUR 150 from private sponsors, EUR 150 from the federal government), usually for at least two semesters and at most the standard study period. Income-independent and not repayable. It does not cover full living costs.

english.note: The language requirement is set by your degree programme.

other: Open to students of all nationalities enrolled (or starting) at a participating state or state-recognised German university
Each university decides whether it takes part and runs its own selection
Selection looks at grades, awards, work and internships, social engagement, and obstacles you overcame
You cannot hold it at the same time as a full DAAD scholarship

deadline.note: There is no national deadline. Each participating university sets its own call and dates.

documents: Proof of awards, work or engagement, if you have them
steps: Get admission to a participating German university (see the map on the official site)
Watch your university's page for its Deutschlandstipendium call
Apply through the university

english.note: The language requirement is set by your degree programme.

other: Open to students of all nationalities enrolled (or starting) at a participating German university; master's programmes are eligible
Each university runs its own selection
You cannot hold it at the same time as a full DAAD scholarship

deadline.note: There is no national deadline. Each participating university sets its own call and dates.

documents: Proof of awards, work or engagement, if you have them
steps: Get admission to a participating German university
Apply through the university's scholarship office when its call opens

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.provider: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
scholarships.funding_details: Fully funded one-year master's degree at a UK university. The official FAQ lists exactly what is covered.

english.note: Check the English requirement of each UK course you apply to.

other: At least two years' work experience after your undergraduate degree, equal to 2,800 hours
An undergraduate degree that qualifies you for a UK master's programme
Apply to three eligible UK courses and hold an unconditional offer from one by the offer deadline
Return to Pakistan for at least two years after the scholarship ends
There is no upper age limit

deadline.note: Applications open in August and close in October; the exact closing date is on the Pakistan country page. The 2027/28 round is closed. Results come in mid-June 2027 and the unconditional offer deadline is 8 July 2027, 17:00 UK time.

documents: Your top three UK master's course choices
Four essays: leadership, relationship-building, your course choices, and your career plan
Two reference letters, uploaded no later than seven working days before your interview
Unconditional offer from a UK university (by the July offer deadline)
steps: Register on the Chevening application system when the round opens in August
Pass the eligibility checker and write the four essays in English
Submit before the October deadline on the Pakistan country page
If shortlisted, interview; referees must upload letters at least seven working days before
Secure an unconditional offer from one of your three courses by the July deadline

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.funding_details: Approved airfare, full tuition fees, a stipend of GBP 1,712 per month (GBP 2,000 in the London metropolitan area), a study travel grant, and a child allowance for single or widowed parents. For one-year taught master's programmes only; MBAs are not funded.

english.note: The CSC does not require an IELTS test, but your UK university may ask for proof of English.

other: By September 2027, a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours, or a lower second-class degree plus a relevant postgraduate qualification
Unable to afford study in the UK without this scholarship
You must apply through a nominator (the national nominating agency is the main route); the CSC takes no direct applications
Commit to returning home after the scholarship
There is no age limit

deadline.note: For 2027/28 the CSC closing date was 16:00 BST on 20 October 2026; nominators set earlier dates. Nominations reach the CSC by December 2026 and results come by July 2027.

documents: Full transcripts for all higher-education qualifications
References from at least two people
Three UK university and course choices
steps: Find your nominating agency for Pakistan on the CSC page and meet its earlier deadline
Complete the CSC application on CSC Central
Name three eligible one-year master's courses
Wait for the nominator, then the CSC, to decide (results by July)

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK with participating UK universities
scholarships.funding_details: Full tuition fees, a stipend of GBP 1,712 per month (GBP 2,000 in the London metropolitan area), airfare, a thesis grant, a study travel grant and a warm clothing allowance. Funded jointly by the CSC and the university.

english.note: The CSC does not require an IELTS test, but universities may require proof of English.

other: By September 2027, a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours, or a lower second-class degree plus a relevant postgraduate qualification
Not studied or worked for one academic year or more in a high-income country
Unable to afford study in the UK without this scholarship
Apply for an approved master's course at a participating UK university
Sign an undertaking to return home after the award; there is no age limit

deadline.note: For 2027/28 applications open on 10 November 2026 and close at 16:00 GMT on 8 December 2026. Universities nominate candidates to the CSC in March 2027.

documents: Two references (PDF), uploaded to CSC Central
steps: Check the 2027 list of approved courses and participating universities
Apply for admission to the course (the university's own process)
Submit the scholarship application on CSC Central between 10 November and 8 December 2026
The university nominates candidates to the CSC in March 2027

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships
scholarships.provider: UK government GREAT Britain Campaign and British Council, with UK universities
scholarships.funding_details: GBP 10,000 towards tuition fees for a one-year taught postgraduate course. For 2026-27, 13 UK universities offered them to students from Pakistan.

english.note: You must meet the English requirement of the UK university.

other: Pakistani passport holder and permanent resident of Pakistan
An undergraduate degree, with interest in the chosen subject
Apply for an eligible one-year taught master's at a participating university (the list changes each year)
Willing to attend GREAT networking events and act as an ambassador

deadline.note: Each university sets its own deadline. The 2026-27 universities for Pakistan were Cardiff, City St George's, Keele, Northumbria, Robert Gordon, SOAS, Manchester, University College Birmingham, UCL, Bath, Glasgow, Leicester and Portsmouth; the 2027-28 list is not out yet.

steps: Open the Pakistan page and pick a participating university
Follow the link to that university's GREAT scholarship page
Apply for the course and the scholarship as the university instructs
The university informs you and pays the award after you register

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship for Pakistan
scholarships.provider: Rhodes Trust (University of Oxford)
scholarships.funding_details: University of Oxford course fees, an annual stipend (GBP 20,400 for 2025-26), the application fee, student visa and Immigration Health Surcharge, two economy flights and a settling-in allowance. Two scholarships for Pakistan each year.
sources: Rhodes Trust 'Checklist for applicants for the Rhodes Scholarship for Pakistan' (2026)

english.note: Oxford sets the English requirement for your course.

other: Age and degree rules for Pakistan are in the 'Information for Candidates' document on the Pakistan page; read it before applying
Academic excellence: consistently one of the top performers in your class
Study a full-time postgraduate course at the University of Oxford

deadline.note: The last Pakistan round opened on 1 June 2026 and closed at 23:59 PKT on 5 August 2026. Applications reopen in 2027 for Oxford entry in 2028.

documents: Copy of a NADRA CNIC or Pakistani passport
Official certified transcript from your college or university
Certified Matric/O-Level, Intermediate/A-Level and undergraduate result sheets
CV of no more than two A4 pages
Personal statement (max. 1,000 words) and academic statement (max. 450 words)
Four referees: three academic and one character referee
steps: Read the Pakistan 'Information for Candidates' when the round opens (June)
Prepare certified documents and contact your four referees early
Submit the online application before the August deadline
Shortlisted candidates go through the Pakistan selection; scholars then apply to their Oxford course

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
scholarships.provider: Hungarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, run by Tempus Public Foundation; HEC is Pakistan's sending partner
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition-free study, HUF 43,700 per month towards living costs (12 months a year), a free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 per month towards rent, and health care plus supplementary insurance up to HUF 65,000 a year (2026/27 call). It is a contribution and does not cover all living costs.
sources: Stipendium Hungaricum Call for Applications 2026/27 (bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's)

english.note: Some Hungarian universities ask for IELTS/TOEFL; most accept an English proficiency certificate from your college or university (HEC).

other: Pakistani or AJ&K citizen, at least 18 years old on or before 31 August of the start year
HAT/USAT score of at least 50% (HEC requirement)
HSSC/Intermediate or equivalent completed before 1 August of the start year (final-year students may apply)
You must apply on both the HEC portal and the Stipendium Hungaricum portal; HEC nominates, TPF decides
Sign a bond with HEC to return to Pakistan and serve after your degree

deadline.note: For 2026/27 the deadline on both portals was 15 January 2026 (14:00 CET on the SH portal, 16:00 PKT on HEC). The 2027/28 call is not published yet.

documents: Online application form in English with a recent photo
HSSC/A-Level certificate and transcripts (IBCC equivalence for O/A Levels)
Medical certificate: only if you win, shown at the medical check in Hungary
steps: Choose up to two study programmes in order of preference (check full-degree vs partial mode)
Apply on the Stipendium Hungaricum portal and the HEC portal before the January deadline
HEC checks and nominates; attest documents (IBCC/HEC) only after nomination
Universities hold entrance exams or interviews
Results by the end of June; arrival in Hungary by September

english.note: Some Hungarian universities ask for IELTS/TOEFL; most accept an English proficiency certificate from your university (HEC).

other: Pakistani or AJ&K citizen
HAT/USAT score of at least 50% (HEC requirement)
A 16-year bachelor's degree completed before 1 August of the start year (final-semester students may apply)
You must apply on both the HEC portal and the Stipendium Hungaricum portal; HEC nominates, TPF decides
Sign a bond with HEC to return to Pakistan and serve after your degree

deadline.note: For 2026/27 the deadline on both portals was 15 January 2026. The 2027/28 call is not published yet.

documents: Online application form in English with a recent photo
Medical certificate: only if you win, shown at the medical check in Hungary
steps: Choose up to two study programmes in order of preference
Apply on the Stipendium Hungaricum portal and the HEC portal before the January deadline
HEC checks and nominates; attest documents (HEC) only after nomination
University interview or exam
Results by the end of June; arrival in Hungary by September

scholarships.name: Italian Government (MAECI) Scholarships for Foreign Students
scholarships.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
scholarships.funding_details: EUR 10,800 in total for 9 months of study (2026/27 call), paid in three instalments, plus collective health insurance. Some universities waive tuition for scholarship holders, but MAECI does not pay tuition and regional fees are always due.

english.note: B2 (CEFR) in the course language: English for English-taught courses, Italian for Italian-taught courses. The call lists which proofs count.

other: Not older than 28 on the call deadline (2026/27 call: born on or after 27 March 1997)
A first-cycle degree equivalent to an Italian bachelor's, to enrol in a Laurea Magistrale
Pakistan was on the list for 2025-26 (the Embassy in Islamabad published the ranking); confirm the yearly country list
Check whether your course needs an admission test or pre-enrolment

deadline.note: The 2026/27 call closed at 14:00 Italian time on 26 March 2026. The 2027/28 call is not published yet; watch the Study in Italy portal.

documents: Degree certificate, or a declaration that you will have it
Language certificate (B2), or upload it later if the call allows
Pre-enrolment or admission proof if your course requires it
steps: Register on the Study in Italy portal and apply before the deadline
If there are many applicants, the commission shortlists and interviews
The Italian Embassy in Islamabad publishes the ranking of winners
Enrol at your university and apply for a study visa before the scholarship starts

scholarships.name: Italian Regional Right-to-Study (DSU) Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Italian regional agencies (e.g. ER.GO in Emilia-Romagna, EDISU in Piedmont)
scholarships.funding_details: Need-based grants from the region where you study. What they cover and the amounts are set in each region's yearly call.

english.note: Set by your degree programme.

other: Family income and assets within the region's limits, proven with documents from Pakistani authorities
Documents must be issued in the year you apply, legalised or apostilled, and translated into Italian
Enrolment at a university in that region

deadline.note: Each regional agency publishes its own call and dates; read your region's call ('bando').

documents: Documents on family income for the previous year and assets as of 31 December, from the competent authorities
Legalisation or apostille of each document
steps: Get admission to an Italian university
Start collecting, apostilling and translating family documents early
Apply on your regional agency's portal (e.g. ER.GO Dossier Utente) by its deadline
Check the ranking and submit new documents every year

english.note: Set by your degree programme.

other: Family income and assets within the region's limits, proven with documents from Pakistani authorities
Documents must be issued in the year you apply, legalised or apostilled, and translated into Italian
Enrolment at a university in that region

deadline.note: Each regional agency publishes its own call and dates.

documents: Family income and asset documents from the competent authorities
Legalisation or apostille and an Italian translation of each document
steps: Get admission
Prepare apostilled and translated family documents
Apply on the regional DSU portal by its deadline

scholarships.name: University of Padua - Padua International Excellence Scholarship Programme
scholarships.provider: University of Padua
scholarships.funding_details: EUR 8,000 (gross) per academic year, paid in two instalments of EUR 4,000, plus exemption from student fees. For 3 years (bachelor's) or 2 years (master's). Up to 76 scholarships.

english.note: Set by the English-taught degree course.

other: Not an Italian citizen (unless dual) and not resident in Italy when you apply
A non-Italian secondary school diploma
Apply to an English-taught bachelor's at Padua within the admission deadline; there is no separate scholarship form

deadline.note: The call for 2027/28 is due to be published in November 2026 with the admission deadlines.

documents: Admission application for an English-taught degree course
steps: Read the 2027/28 call when it is published (November 2026)
Apply for admission to an English-taught course before the deadline
Eligible applicants are ranked automatically

english.note: Set by the English-taught degree course.

other: Not an Italian citizen (unless dual) and not resident in Italy when you apply
A foreign (non-Italian) bachelor's degree
Apply to an English-taught master's at Padua within the admission deadline; there is no separate scholarship form

deadline.note: The call for 2027/28 is due to be published in November 2026 with the admission deadlines.

documents: Admission application for an English-taught master's
steps: Read the 2027/28 call when it is published (November 2026)
Apply for admission to an English-taught master's before the deadline
Eligible applicants are ranked automatically

scholarships.name: Politecnico di Milano - Merit-based International Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Politecnico di Milano
scholarships.funding_details: A full tuition-fee waiver (you pay only an administrative fee of about EUR 170); some scholarships add a gross allowance of up to EUR 10,000 per year.

english.note: A valid English certificate must be submitted by 4 March 2027 to be considered.

other: International student applying to the first year of an English-taught Master of Science (first-semester start)
Your admission application fee must be paid in the Early bird period (1 October - 1 December 2026)
Selection is based on your previous education (GPA and achievements), its match with the programme, your documents and the scholarship form
Note: Pakistan is not on the separate 'Invest Your Talent in Italy' country list

deadline.note: For 2027/28 you must apply for admission and pay the fee in the Early bird window, 1 October - 1 December 2026; English certificate by 4 March 2027. Full dates are in the call.

documents: Admission application through Politecnico di Milano Online Services
Portfolio if your programme asks for one
steps: Choose an English-taught MSc starting in the first semester
Apply for admission and pay the fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026
Submit the scholarship application form on Online Services
Upload your English certificate by 4 March 2027

scholarships.name: Ca' Foscari University of Venice - Ca' Foscari Honours Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Ca' Foscari University of Venice
scholarships.funding_details: EUR 10,000 per year, renewed each year. For 2027/28: 8 scholarships for new bachelor's students (for three years) and 20 for new master's students (for two years).

english.note: A language certificate for the course language (Italian or English) is part of the application.

other: International student educated outside the Italian system, enrolling in a bachelor's taught in Italian or English
Cumulative grade average of at least 85% when you apply
Ranked on points; renewal each year depends on the rules in the call

deadline.note: The 2027/28 call with deadlines will be published on the official page in late fall 2026.

steps: Watch the official page for the 2027/28 call (late fall 2026)
Apply for admission and for the scholarship as the call explains
Applicants are given points and ranked

english.note: A language certificate for the course language (Italian or English) is part of the application.

other: International student educated outside the Italian system, enrolling in a master's taught in Italian or English
CGPA of at least 85% when you apply
Ranked on points; renewal each year depends on the rules in the call

deadline.note: The 2027/28 call with deadlines will be published on the official page in late fall 2026.

steps: Watch the official page for the 2027/28 call (late fall 2026)
Apply for admission and for the scholarship as the call explains
Applicants are given points and ranked

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarships
scholarships.provider: European Union (EACEA) and university consortia
scholarships.funding_details: Covers participation costs and contributes to travel, visa and living costs, for joint master's programmes of 1 to 2 years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS) taught in two or more European countries. All students receive the same scholarship regardless of nationality.

english.note: Each programme sets its own English score.

other: A bachelor's degree, or be in the last year of your bachelor's
Apply directly to each programme's consortium; rules differ by programme

deadline.note: Each programme sets its own dates; in most cases you apply between October and January for courses starting the next academic year.

documents: Other documents the programme lists (often CV, motivation letter and recommendations)
steps: Search the Erasmus Mundus catalogue
Shortlist programmes and read each one's rules and deadline
Apply on each programme's own website

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship - Undergraduate (Embassy Recommendation)
scholarships.provider: Japanese Ministry of Education (MEXT) through the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition exempted, 117,000 yen per month and round-trip airfare. Includes one year of preparatory Japanese and other subjects before university (2027 guidelines).

english.note: Selection includes the embassy's written tests and an interview. In principle you must be willing to study in Japanese.

other: For the 2027 intake: born on or after 2 April 2002
12 years of schooling (Matric + Intermediate / O + A Levels) completed by March of the start year
Willing to learn Japanese and, in principle, to study in Japanese
Health certificate signed by a doctor; able to arrive in Japan in early April

deadline.note: For the 2027 scholarship the embassy deadline was 5 June 2026. The call usually comes out around April-May.

documents: Application form (1 original) and placement preference form
Matric/O-Level and Intermediate/A-Level mark sheets (attested copies)
Attested certificate of graduation (or prospective graduation)
Recommendation letter from a class teacher or principal
Certificate of enrolment, if currently studying
Hope certificate if your final result is expected by August
steps: Download the guidelines and forms from Study in Japan when the call opens
Post the documents unstapled on A4 to the Embassy (Islamabad) or the Consulate General (Karachi)
Only shortlisted candidates are called for the written test and interview
MEXT makes the final selection

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship - Research Student (Embassy Recommendation)
scholarships.provider: MEXT through the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition exempted, round-trip airfare, and 143,000 yen per month as a research (non-regular) student or 144,000 yen per month in a master's course (2027 guidelines). You may start as a research student and move into a master's.

english.note: The embassy tests shortlisted candidates in Japanese and English; your Japanese university may ask for its own proof.

other: For the 2027 intake: born on or after 2 April 1992
Eligible for admission to a Japanese master's programme (16 years of education)
Willing to learn Japanese
A clear field of study and research plan

deadline.note: For the 2027 scholarship the embassy deadline was 26 May 2026. Recruitment is between April and May of the year before arrival.

documents: Application form (1 original) and placement preference form
Field of Study and Research Plan
Degree (or hope certificate) and transcripts, attested by your university
Recommendation letter from the president/dean or your academic advisor
Recommendation from your current employer (if employed)
Certificate of Health completed by a doctor
steps: Download the guidelines and forms from Study in Japan when the call opens (April)
Post the documents unstapled on A4 to the Embassy (Islamabad) or the Consulate General in Karachi
Only shortlisted candidates take the test and interview
Get a letter of acceptance from a Japanese university
MEXT makes the final selection

scholarships.name: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program
scholarships.provider: Asian Development Bank, funded by Japan
scholarships.funding_details: Full tuition, a monthly subsistence allowance (including housing), books and materials, medical insurance and travel expenses, at designated institutions.

english.note: Good spoken and written English; the institution sets any test score.

other: Bachelor's degree with a superior academic record
At least two years of full-time work after your degree, at the time of application
Not more than 35 years old when you apply
Admission to an approved master's course at a designated institution; not already enrolled in a graduate programme
Return and work in Pakistan for at least two years after your studies

deadline.note: Each designated institution has its own deadline (many Japanese universities between November and January). Apply at least six months before the start.

documents: Latest income tax return or salary certificate
steps: Choose a designated institution and course from ADB's list
Apply for admission and tick the ADB-JSP box; no separate application to ADB
The institution screens and ranks candidates
ADB reviews, and Japan's Executive Director approves the awards

scholarships.name: JDS (Project for Human Resource Development Scholarship) - Pakistan
scholarships.provider: Government of Japan grant aid, run by JICE
scholarships.funding_details: All the costs of a 2-year master's in Japan are covered by JDS. 16 master's places for Pakistan each year. For Pakistani government officers only.

english.note: Every qualified applicant must take an IELTS arranged in the selection; IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 500-550 is preferable, not required.

other: Cadre officer of an occupational group of the Federal Government, or ex-cadre federal officer (BPS-17 and above)
Between 25 and 40 years old on 1 April 2027
At least 3 years of full-time work in public service (including probation)
A bachelor's degree with 16 years of formal education
Not eligible if you already earned a foreign-funded master's abroad, hold another scholarship, or are military personnel

deadline.note: For the 2027-2028 intake the deadline is 27 November 2026 (online). IELTS and maths tests in Nov-Dec 2026, interviews Feb-Mar 2027, departure in August 2027.

documents: Documents listed on pages 6-8 of the Application Guidelines (password from JICE)
steps: Download the guidelines and forms (password from JICE) from the JDS Pakistan page
Prepare the documents and fill in the online form
Upload and submit by 27 November 2026
Sit the IELTS and maths tests, then document screening and interviews

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), Australia Awards - South Asia & Mongolia
scholarships.funding_details: Full tuition fees, return airfares, a contribution to living expenses and medical insurance, for full-time postgraduate study in Australia.

english.note: The English score and other country rules are on the Pakistan page when the round opens, and in the DFAT Scholarships Policy Handbook.

other: Pakistani national meeting the Pakistan-specific criteria published before each round
Return home and contribute to development for at least two years after the scholarship
Women, people with disability and people from marginalised groups are encouraged to apply

deadline.note: Applications open on 1 February and close on 30 April each year. The 2026 round is closed; it reopens in early 2027.

documents: Documents listed on the Pakistan page for the round
steps: Read the Pakistan country page when the round opens (1 February)
Apply on the Online Australia Awards Scholarships Information System (OASIS) by 30 April
